description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the Awsetry namespace. It provides methods to generate configuration objects for AWS SDK retries, including default, environment-based, fallback, and ini file-based configurations. It also includes logic to unwrap various configuration formats into a standard ConfigurationInterface object.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods to generate AWS SDK retry configurations from various sources such as environment variables, ini files, or defaults.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, ini files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that reads retry settings from environment variables.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback retry configuration with default mode and attempts.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider based on ini file settings, with optional profile and filename parameters.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Converts various configuration representations into a ConfigurationInterface object.
